plan: Cycle 1 QA test cases — Asset Inventory Web Application
environment: Docker Compose: frontend :3000, backend :8000, postgres, redis; seeded demo users admin/manager/deptmgr/operator/employee/auditor and ~200 assets

test_cases.title: Clean environment bring-up via documented scripts
test_cases.objective: Verify that dev-up, migrate, and seed scripts yield a working full-stack app per cycle DoD.
test_cases.preconditions: Clean checkout; Docker available; .env created from .env.example.
test_cases.test_data: Default .env.example values; seed dataset per design §10.4.
test_cases.expected_result: All scripts succeed idempotently; frontend serves at :3000; backend ready endpoint returns 200; seeded data visible after login.

test_cases.title: Repo hygiene: no secrets, .env ignored, lockfiles present
test_cases.objective: Verify no real secrets committed, .env is git-ignored, and pnpm/uv lockfiles exist.
steps: Check .env is not tracked and listed in .gitignore
Scan tracked files for secret-like strings (passwords, keys, tokens) excluding .env.example placeholders
Verify frontend lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml) and backend lockfile (uv.lock or documented alternative) are committed
test_cases.expected_result: No secrets in tracked files; .env ignored; lockfiles present.

test_cases.title: Backend quality gates pass (ruff format/check, mypy, makemigrations --check, pytest)
test_cases.objective: Execute backend CI-mirror quality commands from design §15.3 where allowlisted.
test_cases.preconditions: backend/ deliverable present; commands available via run_allowlisted_command.
steps: Run ruff format --check and ruff check
test_cases.expected_result: All commands exit 0. Any non-allowlisted command recorded as BLOCKED with the valid-key list as evidence.

test_cases.title: Frontend quality gates pass (lint, typecheck, unit tests, build)
test_cases.objective: Execute frontend CI-mirror quality commands where allowlisted.
test_cases.expected_result: All commands exit 0; production build succeeds. Non-allowlisted commands recorded as BLOCKED.

test_cases.title: Health endpoints are unauthenticated and infra-only
test_cases.objective: Verify /api/v1/health/live and /health/ready return 200 without auth and expose no sensitive data.
steps: Inspect response bodies for internal paths/versions/secrets
test_cases.expected_result: Both return 200 with minimal non-sensitive payload; no stack traces, credentials, or internal details.

test_cases.title: Scripts are re-runnable (idempotent)
test_cases.objective: Verify dev-up/migrate/seed can be re-run without errors or duplicate seed data corruption.
test_cases.preconditions: Stack already up and seeded once.
steps: Verify asset/reference counts unchanged or documented idempotent behavior
test_cases.expected_result: Scripts succeed; no duplicate reference rows; behavior matches README documentation.

test_cases.title: Valid login establishes session
test_cases.objective: Verify POST /auth/login with valid credentials returns success, sets session cookie, and /auth/me returns the user with role/scopes/capabilities.
steps: POST /auth/login with valid credentials and CSRF header
test_cases.expected_result: Login 200; sessionid cookie HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax (Secure when not local); /auth/me 200 with uuid, display name, role, scopes, capability flags; no password/hash in payload.

test_cases.title: Invalid credentials return generic error without account enumeration
test_cases.objective: Verify wrong-password and nonexistent-user attempts yield identical generic failure responses.
test_cases.test_data: (existing user, wrong password); (nonexistent user, any password).
steps: POST /auth/login with existing user + wrong password
Compare HTTP status, error code, message text, and timing roughness
test_cases.expected_result: Both return 401 with the same generic code/message; no indication whether the account exists; failure audit event recorded.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated API access returns 401 envelope
test_cases.objective: Verify protected endpoints reject anonymous requests with the standard error envelope.
test_cases.expected_result: All return 401 with envelope {error:{code:AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, message, field_errors, correlation_id, retryable}}.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated page visit redirects to login with return URL; deep link honored
test_cases.objective: Verify visiting /assets/<uuid> unauthenticated redirects to /login?next=... and lands on the original page after sign-in.
test_cases.expected_result: Redirect to /login?next=/assets/<uuid>; after login user lands on the asset detail page.

test_cases.title: Logout invalidates session
test_cases.objective: Verify POST /auth/logout ends the session server-side and /auth/me then returns 401.
steps: GET /auth/me with the same (old) session cookie
test_cases.expected_result: Logout 200/204; subsequent /auth/me returns 401; logout audit event recorded.

test_cases.title: CSRF enforced on unsafe methods
test_cases.objective: Verify POST/PATCH without X-CSRFToken header are rejected for session-authenticated requests.
steps: Attempt POST /assets with session cookie but no CSRF header
test_cases.expected_result: Missing/invalid CSRF → 403; correct token → request processed normally.

test_cases.title: Session cookie flags and rotation on login
test_cases.objective: Verify sessionid cookie attributes and that the session key rotates at login (session-fixation mitigation).
steps: Obtain pre-login session cookie if any
test_cases.expected_result: HttpOnly present; SameSite=Lax; Secure set when served over HTTPS/non-local; session identifier rotates on login.

test_cases.title: Login success/failure/logout produce audit events
test_cases.objective: Verify audit events are written for successful login, failed login, and logout with actor/outcome/timestamp/correlation ID.
test_cases.preconditions: Admin or auditor access to audit query surface (API or Django admin/shell as documented).
steps: Perform failed login, successful login, logout
Query audit events for the actor
test_cases.expected_result: Three events exist with action, actor, UTC timestamp, outcome, correlation_id; no credentials stored in audit payload.

test_cases.title: Login rate limiting / lockout backoff
test_cases.objective: Verify repeated failed logins are throttled (429 RATE_LIMITED) per documented policy.
test_cases.preconditions: Backend running with rate limiting enabled (dev config may use cache backend).
steps: Send repeated failed login attempts in quick succession
test_cases.expected_result: After configured threshold, responses become 429 with RATE_LIMITED envelope and retryable/backoff indication; policy documented.

test_cases.title: Expired/invalid session UX returns user to sign-in
test_cases.objective: Verify a 401 mid-session clears client state and redirects to /login?next=... with a non-confusing message.
test_cases.preconditions: Logged-in UI session; ability to expire session (delete cookie server-side or wait/shorten timeout in test config).
steps: Trigger a navigation or API call
test_cases.expected_result: User redirected to sign-in with return URL; no stale private data remains displayed; no raw exception shown.

test_cases.title: Role capability: employee/auditor cannot create assets via API
test_cases.objective: Verify direct POST /assets as employee or auditor is denied server-side.
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded employee and auditor users; valid asset payload.
test_cases.test_data: Valid create payload per category required fields.
test_cases.expected_result: Both 403 PERMISSION_DENIED envelope; no asset created; denial does not leak data.

test_cases.title: Scope filtering on asset list
test_cases.objective: Verify a department-scoped user (deptmgr) sees only in-scope assets in GET /assets while admin/manager see the full permitted set.
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded assets across ≥2 departments; deptmgr scoped to one department.
steps: GET /assets as deptmgr; record count and departments
test_cases.expected_result: deptmgr results contain only in-scope assets; count < admin count; envelope pagination consistent.

test_cases.title: Direct API access to out-of-scope asset yields 404/403 without leak
test_cases.objective: Verify object-scope check on GET/PATCH /assets/:uuid for an out-of-scope asset, with no existence/data leak.
test_cases.preconditions: UUID of an asset outside deptmgr scope (obtained as admin).
steps: As admin, identify out-of-scope asset UUID
test_cases.expected_result: 404 (or 403 per design) with generic envelope; response identical in shape to a truly nonexistent UUID; no fields leaked.

test_cases.title: Financial fields restricted by role
test_cases.objective: Verify purchase price / financial fields are absent from serializer output for roles without finance.view and present for authorized roles.
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded asset with purchase_price; users with and without finance permission.
steps: GET /assets/<uuid> as role without finance.view (e.g. employee/operator per matrix)
GET same as authorized role (e.g. admin/manager)
test_cases.expected_result: Financial fields omitted (not null-masked) for unauthorized role; present as money object {amount, currency} for authorized role.

test_cases.title: Reference-data write restricted to admin
test_cases.objective: Verify POST/PATCH on reference-data endpoints is denied for non-admin roles.
steps: As manager, PATCH an existing category
test_cases.expected_result: Non-admin roles get 403; admin succeeds; unauthorized attempts audited if policy requires.

test_cases.title: UI hides unauthorized actions
test_cases.objective: Verify create/edit buttons and admin nav items are hidden for roles lacking capability, driven by /auth/me capability flags.
test_cases.preconditions: Frontend running; auditor and operator users.
steps: Login as auditor; inspect /assets page for New Asset button and row edit actions
Login as operator; confirm actions present
test_cases.expected_result: Auditor sees no mutation controls; operator sees them; hiding is UX-only and backend still enforces (covered by TC-FR-002-01).

test_cases.title: Vertical escalation attempt: employee PATCH asset denied
test_cases.objective: Verify a low-privilege role cannot modify assets by direct API call even with a valid in-scope UUID.
test_cases.preconditions: Employee user; UUID of an asset visible to them.
test_cases.expected_result: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; asset unchanged; no audit entry showing a successful mutation.

test_cases.title: Auditor read-only across mutation endpoints
test_cases.objective: Verify auditor can GET permitted resources but all POST/PATCH/DELETE are denied (assets, saved-views write for others, reference-data).
test_cases.expected_result: Reads succeed within scope; all mutations 403.

test_cases.title: Create asset happy path creates asset + lifecycle event + audit event atomically
test_cases.objective: Verify POST /assets with valid data returns 201 and produces the initial LifecycleEvent and AuditEvent in one transaction.
test_cases.test_data: Laptop payload: name 'QA Laptop 01', category Laptop, status In Stock, condition New, department, location, acquisition_type purchased.
steps: Query audit events for the asset
test_cases.expected_result: 201 with UUID and server/validated tag; history shows registration event with actor+timestamp; audit event with after-values and correlation_id; all-or-nothing on failure paths.

test_cases.title: Required-field validation returns per-field 400 errors
test_cases.objective: Verify missing required fields yield 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with field_errors identifying each field and how to fix it.
test_cases.test_data: Payload missing name, category, status, condition, department, location, acquisition_type.
test_cases.expected_result: 400 envelope code VALIDATION_FAILED; field_errors entry per missing field; no asset created.

test_cases.title: Asset tag uniqueness enforced (all-time)
test_cases.objective: Verify creating an asset with a tag already used (including by retired/disposed assets if present) fails with DUPLICATE_TAG.
steps: POST /assets with explicit tag equal to existing tag
test_cases.expected_result: 409 (or 400 per contract) with stable code DUPLICATE_TAG; no second asset with same tag.

test_cases.title: Server-generated tags unique under concurrent creation
test_cases.objective: Verify concurrent POST /assets without explicit tags receive distinct server-generated tags (AssetTagSequence locked increments).
test_cases.test_data: 10 identical minimal payloads differing only by name.
test_cases.expected_result: All succeed; 10 distinct tags; no sequence collisions or 500s.

test_cases.title: Duplicate-detection pre-check returns non-blocking warnings
test_cases.objective: Verify POST /assets/:uuid/check-duplicates (or create-time warnings) flags matching serial / manufacturer+model without blocking save.
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded asset with known serial_number and manufacturer+model.
test_cases.test_data: Payload reusing that serial number; variant reusing manufacturer+model.
steps: Call duplicate check with colliding serial
test_cases.expected_result: Warnings array identifies the matching fields/candidates; save still succeeds (non-blocking); no auto-merge occurs.

test_cases.title: Draft save permitted with incomplete operational fields
test_cases.objective: Verify an asset can be saved in Draft status when not all operational fields are available (where permitted).
test_cases.test_data: Payload with status=Draft, minimal identity fields.
steps: POST /assets with Draft status and minimal fields
test_cases.expected_result: 201; asset stored with Draft status; validation rules for Draft documented and applied (relaxed per design).

test_cases.title: Category-driven required/category-specific fields enforced
test_cases.objective: Verify required CategoryAttributeDefinitions are validated at creation and unknown attribute keys rejected or handled per contract.
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded category with required attribute definitions.
test_cases.test_data: Payload missing required category attribute; payload with wrong-typed attribute value.
steps: POST with type-mismatched attribute (e.g. text into number)
test_cases.expected_result: 400 field_errors for missing/invalid attributes; valid payload persists attributes in category_attributes JSONB.

test_cases.title: XSS payload in text fields stored and rendered safely
test_cases.objective: Verify script/HTML injection in name/description is escaped on render and never executed.
test_cases.test_data: name: QA-XSS; description with .
steps: Open list, detail, and search results
test_cases.expected_result: Payloads render as inert text (escaped); no script execution; stored value retrievable verbatim via API.

test_cases.title: Money fields use decimal-string + currency representation
test_cases.objective: Verify purchase_price serializes as {amount: "1234.56", currency: "USD"} and floats are never used.
steps: Create with 0.10 and verify no float artifacts
test_cases.expected_result: Amount serialized as string preserving scale; currency ISO 4217; values exact (no 0.10000000001).

test_cases.title: Asset detail view renders identity, status, condition, and history
test_cases.objective: Verify GET /assets/:uuid and the detail page present current information plus history tab data.
steps: Verify identity header (tag, name, status badge, condition badge)
Open history tab and verify events reverse-chronological
test_cases.expected_result: All identity fields shown; status/condition badges have icon+text (not color alone); history lists actor, timestamp, summary.

test_cases.title: Edit asset with current version succeeds and increments version
test_cases.objective: Verify PATCH with correct If-Match/version updates fields, increments version, and writes audit before/after.
test_cases.preconditions: Operator login; asset UUID + current version.
test_cases.expected_result: 200; version incremented by 1; change persisted; audit event has before/after for changed fields, actor, timestamp, correlation_id.

test_cases.title: Stale version rejected with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT
test_cases.objective: Verify a second save based on an outdated version fails and does not overwrite the newer changes.
test_cases.test_data: Two PATCH payloads both based on version N.
steps: PATCH A with version N (succeeds, now N+1)
GET asset and confirm only A's change present
test_cases.expected_result: Second PATCH → 409 with code VERSION_CONFLICT; server state reflects first save only; error message explains conflict.

test_cases.title: UI prompts user on 409 conflict
test_cases.objective: Verify the edit form surfaces a clear conflict prompt (not silent data loss) when the backend returns 409.
test_cases.preconditions: Two sessions (or simulated stale form) editing same asset.
test_cases.test_data: Same asset edited in two browser contexts.
steps: Open edit form in contexts A and B
test_cases.expected_result: B sees conflict message with option to reload/review; no silent overwrite; user's entered values preserved.

test_cases.title: Validation errors identify field and correction; other entries preserved
test_cases.objective: Verify server and client validation messages are field-specific and a single invalid field does not erase other valid form entries.
test_cases.test_data: Invalid date (warranty_end < warranty_start — BR-005); otherwise valid form.
steps: Inspect error summary and field values
test_cases.expected_result: Error names the field and the rule violated; error summary receives focus; all other entered values retained.

test_cases.title: Date-consistency rules enforced server-side
test_cases.objective: Verify warranty_end < warranty_start (and similar row-local date rules) are rejected with clear validation errors.
steps: POST or PATCH with inverted warranty dates
test_cases.expected_result: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with field_errors on warranty_end explaining the rule.

test_cases.title: Global search matches tag/serial/name/model with exact tag first
test_cases.objective: Verify GET /search/assets?q= finds assets across fields and ranks an exact tag match first.
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded assets with known tag, serial, name, model.
test_cases.test_data: Queries: exact tag; partial serial; name fragment; model.
steps: Inspect result ordering for the exact-tag query
test_cases.expected_result: All queries return matching assets; exact-tag query places that asset first; response scoped and paginated.

test_cases.title: Search results respect permission scope
test_cases.objective: Verify a scoped user's search never returns out-of-scope assets even when the query matches them.
test_cases.preconditions: Out-of-scope asset with distinctive serial known to admin.
steps: As deptmgr, search the out-of-scope serial
test_cases.expected_result: deptmgr gets empty/in-scope-only results; admin finds the asset.

test_cases.title: List filters by category, status, condition, department, location
test_cases.objective: Verify each filter narrows GET /assets correctly and filters can be combined.
test_cases.test_data: Known filter values from seed; combinations (category+status).
steps: Apply each filter individually and verify every returned row matches
test_cases.expected_result: All returned rows match filter criteria; counts consistent; combined filters intersect.

test_cases.title: Sorting ascending/descending on supported columns
test_cases.objective: Verify ordering parameter sorts results correctly and stably.
steps: Verify sequence correctness across at least two pages
test_cases.expected_result: Results correctly ordered; pagination preserves ordering across pages; invalid ordering field handled per contract.

test_cases.title: Pagination envelope and page_size limits
test_cases.objective: Verify {count, next, previous, results} envelope, default page_size 25, and max page_size 100 enforced.
test_cases.expected_result: Envelope shape correct; default 25; 100 honored; >100 clamped or 400 per contract; next/previous URLs valid and consistent.

test_cases.title: Filter/sort/page state reflected in URL query params
test_cases.objective: Verify the asset register syncs state to the URL so views are bookmarkable/shareable.
test_cases.test_data: Filter: status=In Stock; sort by name; page 2.
test_cases.expected_result: URL contains query params; new tab restores identical view.

test_cases.title: Combined filter+sort+pagination consistency (no duplicates/gaps)
test_cases.objective: Verify iterating all pages of a filtered+sorted query returns each matching record exactly once.
steps: Page through entire result set collecting UUIDs
Check duplicates and total vs count
test_cases.expected_result: Collected UUID set size == count; no duplicates; no omissions.

test_cases.title: Empty result set shows helpful empty state
test_cases.objective: Verify a query with no matches renders an empty state explaining why and suggesting next action (clear filters).
test_cases.expected_result: Accessible empty state with explanation + clear-filters action; no error banner; no blank page.

test_cases.title: Saved views: create, apply, update, delete own view
test_cases.objective: Verify full CRUD on own saved views via API and UI.
test_cases.test_data: View config {filters: {status: In Stock}, ordering: name}, name 'QA View 1'.
test_cases.expected_result: 201/create, list, update, delete all succeed for own views; config round-trips intact.

test_cases.title: Cannot modify another user's private saved view
test_cases.objective: Verify horizontal access control on saved views.
test_cases.preconditions: Two users; view owned by user A.
steps: As user B, GET/PATCH/DELETE user A's private view
test_cases.expected_result: 404/403 without leaking view content; A's view unchanged.

test_cases.title: Shared view publishing restricted to authorized roles
test_cases.objective: Verify only authorized roles can set shared=true; shared views visible to others.
test_cases.preconditions: Operator (unauthorized to publish) and manager (authorized) per design defaults — confirm actual matrix.
steps: As unauthorized role, attempt to publish
As third user, list shared views
test_cases.expected_result: Unauthorized publish → 403; authorized publish succeeds and view appears for other users.

test_cases.title: Default view selection applied on register load
test_cases.objective: Verify marking a view as default causes the asset register to load with that configuration.
test_cases.expected_result: Register loads with default view's filters/sort; indicator shows active view name.

test_cases.title: Dashboard summary returns scoped aggregates reconciling with asset list
test_cases.objective: Verify GET /dashboard/summary totals equal counts from filtered /assets queries for the same user.
test_cases.preconditions: Seed data; deptmgr and admin users.
steps: GET /dashboard/summary as admin; compare total with /assets count
Compare per-status breakdown with filtered counts
test_cases.expected_result: All aggregates reconcile exactly with permitted record sets; scoped user sees only in-scope totals (no misleading cross-scope numbers).

test_cases.title: Dashboard KPI cards render with loading/empty/error states
test_cases.objective: Verify dashboard shows KPI cards, handles backend failure with error state + correlation ID, and shows last-refreshed indicator if specified.
test_cases.preconditions: Frontend running; ability to simulate API failure (stop backend or mock).
steps: Load dashboard; observe skeleton then cards
test_cases.expected_result: Skeleton during load; KPI cards with values; graceful error state with support reference; recovery on retry.

test_cases.title: Dashboard indicators link to filtered asset lists
test_cases.objective: Verify clicking a KPI (e.g. by status) navigates to /assets with the corresponding filter applied.
test_cases.preconditions: Frontend running; seeded data with non-zero KPIs.
steps: Verify destination URL and list contents match KPI count
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation to filtered list; list count matches KPI number for that scope.

test_cases.title: Audit events for asset create/update contain required fields
test_cases.objective: Verify actor, action, UTC timestamp, target, before/after, outcome, correlation_id on asset mutation audit events.
test_cases.preconditions: Ability to read audit events (admin API, Django admin, or DB inspection as documented).
test_cases.test_data: One create + one update performed with known X-Correlation-ID.
steps: Perform create and update supplying X-Correlation-ID header
Validate fields and correlation ID match
test_cases.expected_result: Events contain all required fields; before/after accurate; correlation_id matches supplied header.

test_cases.title: Audit records not editable/deletable via application API
test_cases.objective: Verify no API path allows modifying or deleting audit events (append-only).
steps: Attempt PATCH/DELETE on any audit event resource via API
Attempt via Django admin if exposed
test_cases.expected_result: All modification attempts denied/impossible; hash-chain fields (if implemented C1) intact; attempts logged if policy requires.

test_cases.title: Correlation ID propagation end-to-end
test_cases.objective: Verify X-Correlation-ID supplied by client is echoed in response headers/envelope and appears in logs/audit; absent ID is generated.
steps: Check backend log line contains same ID
Send request without header and verify one is generated
test_cases.expected_result: Echo present; log correlation; generated UUID when absent.

test_cases.title: Reference-data read endpoints return seeded data
test_cases.objective: Verify GET on categories, statuses, conditions, departments, locations, cost-centers, suppliers returns seeded records with pagination envelope.
steps: GET each endpoint as authenticated user
Validate shape and non-empty seeded content
test_cases.expected_result: 200 with consistent envelope; seeded defaults present (13 statuses, 6 conditions per spec §8).

test_cases.title: Admin reference-data create/update is audited
test_cases.objective: Verify admin can create/update reference records and changes produce audit events.
test_cases.test_data: New department {name: 'QA Dept', code: 'QADEPT'}; then PATCH description.
test_cases.expected_result: Create/update succeed; audit events recorded with before/after; unique code enforced.

test_cases.title: Referenced in-use reference records cannot be hard-deleted
test_cases.objective: Verify attempts to delete a department/location referenced by assets are rejected (deactivate-not-delete).
steps: As admin, attempt DELETE (or deactivation flow) on in-use record
Verify referenced assets still resolve the record
test_cases.expected_result: Hard delete rejected (405/409/PROTECT); historical references intact; inactive values hidden from new selections but visible on existing records.

test_cases.title: Error envelope shape consistent across 400/401/403/404/409
test_cases.objective: Verify all non-2xx responses use the standard envelope with stable codes, correlation_id, and retryable flag.
test_cases.preconditions: Stack running; users of various roles.
test_cases.test_data: Requests engineered to produce each status class.
steps: Trigger 400 (bad payload), 401 (no auth), 403 (wrong role), 404 (random UUID), 409 (stale version)
test_cases.expected_result: Every error body matches {error:{code,message,field_errors,correlation_id,retryable}}; codes from the documented stable set.

test_cases.title: Unhandled errors return generic 500 without stack trace
test_cases.objective: Verify a forced server error yields INTERNAL_ERROR envelope with correlation ID and no internals.
test_cases.preconditions: A way to trigger 500 (malformed input edge case or test hook documented by backend).
test_cases.expected_result: 500 with generic message + correlation_id; no stack trace, paths, SQL, or versions; full trace only in server logs.

test_cases.title: OpenAPI schema available and exportable
test_cases.objective: Verify /api/v1/schema/ serves the spec and backend/openapi.json export exists/matches for frontend type generation.
steps: Compare with committed backend/openapi.json if present
test_cases.expected_result: Valid OpenAPI document covering delivered endpoints; exported artifact consistent (contract drift fails build per design §14).

test_cases.title: Public identifiers are UUIDs; internal PKs not exposed
test_cases.objective: Verify URLs and payloads use uuid identifiers and never expose bigint internal IDs.
steps: Inspect representative API responses for identifier fields
Attempt access via sequential numeric ID
test_cases.expected_result: Only UUIDs exposed; numeric-ID access fails; no internal PK leakage in any field.

test_cases.title: Correlation ID generated client-side and attached by useApi
test_cases.objective: Verify frontend API client attaches X-Correlation-ID (UUIDv4) to every request and surfaces it in error UI.
test_cases.preconditions: Frontend running with browser devtools/network capture.
steps: Perform UI actions; inspect request headers for X-Correlation-ID
Trigger an error; confirm UI error state shows the correlation ID as support reference
test_cases.expected_result: Header present on all API calls; error surfaces the ID; no raw exception text displayed.

test_cases.title: No horizontal page scroll at 320px on delivered pages
test_cases.objective: Verify login, dashboard, asset register, detail, create/edit render without page-level horizontal scrolling at 320×568.
test_cases.preconditions: Frontend running; browser with viewport emulation.
steps: Check document scrollWidth vs innerWidth and visual overflow
test_cases.expected_result: No horizontal scrollbar; all primary actions reachable; content not clipped.

test_cases.title: Asset register switches table ↔ cards responsively
test_cases.objective: Verify desktop table view switches to card list on mobile with essential fields and actions preserved.
steps: View register at desktop width (table, sticky header, sortable columns)
View at mobile width (cards: tag, name, status badge, category/model, custodian, location, action menu)
test_cases.expected_result: Pattern switch per design; cards contain required fields; actions accessible via menu.

test_cases.title: Navigation shells per breakpoint (sidebar / rail / bottom nav)
test_cases.objective: Verify desktop collapsible sidebar, tablet rail/drawer, mobile top bar + bottom nav with aria-current on active section.
test_cases.expected_result: Correct shell per breakpoint; aria-current present; mobile 'More' drawer works; Scan/Tasks stubs show accessible coming-soon state.

test_cases.title: Touch targets ≥44×44px on mobile
test_cases.objective: Verify interactive elements meet minimum touch target size on compact viewports.
test_cases.test_data: Bottom nav items, card action menus, pagination controls.
steps: Measure key interactive elements at mobile viewport
test_cases.expected_result: All primary touch targets ≥44×44px CSS pixels or adequately spaced per WCAG 2.2 target-size guidance.

test_cases.title: Keyboard-only pass: sign-in, asset register, asset detail
test_cases.objective: Verify full keyboard operability: tab order logical, visible focus, skip link works, no traps, Escape closes overlays with focus restore.
steps: Tab through login and submit via keyboard
Navigate sidebar/top bar, open register, sort a column, paginate, open an asset
Open a dialog/menu and close with Escape
test_cases.expected_result: All actions achievable by keyboard; focus always visible; Escape restores focus to trigger; skip link jumps to main content.

test_cases.title: Automated axe-core scan on delivered pages
test_cases.objective: Run axe-core on login, dashboard, register, detail, create/edit; zero critical/serious violations.
test_cases.preconditions: Browser automation available (Playwright + axe-core) else MANUAL fallback with browser extension.
test_cases.expected_result: No critical or serious violations; moderate/minor documented with tickets if present.

test_cases.title: Status/condition not conveyed by color alone
test_cases.objective: Verify every status/condition badge pairs semantic color with icon + text label + screen-reader text.
test_cases.test_data: Badges on register and detail pages.
steps: Inspect badges visually and in accessibility tree
test_cases.expected_result: Meaning preserved without color; icon+label present; accessible name describes status.

test_cases.title: Form error association and focus management
test_cases.objective: Verify failed submit shows error summary receiving focus, per-field errors programmatically associated (aria-describedby), labels not placeholder-only.
test_cases.test_data: Submit with multiple missing required fields.
steps: Inspect focus target, aria attributes, and label associations
test_cases.expected_result: Focus moves to error summary; each error linked to its field; all inputs have persistent labels.

test_cases.title: Landmarks, headings, skip link, live regions
test_cases.objective: Verify semantic landmarks (header/nav/main/footer), logical heading hierarchy, and live regions for dynamic updates (toasts, async results).
steps: Inspect landmark structure and heading outline on each delivered page
Trigger a toast/async update and check live-region announcement markup
test_cases.expected_result: Correct landmarks; no skipped heading levels that break navigation; dynamic updates announced via aria-live or role=status.

test_cases.title: Dark-theme token contrast meets WCAG AA
test_cases.objective: Spot-check contrast ratios for text/background token pairs from layout §5.2 (e.g. #F3F6FA on #121A26, #B8C4D1 on #0D131D, accent #5EA2FF usage).
test_cases.test_data: Token pairs used for body text, muted text, badges, focus ring, buttons.
steps: Compute contrast ratios for each used pairing
Flag any pairing < 4.5:1 (normal text) or < 3:1 (large text/UI components)
test_cases.expected_result: All used pairings meet AA; focus ring #8CC8FF visible against surfaces.

test_cases.title: Performance smoke: asset list and search respond within targets on seed data
test_cases.objective: Verify filtered asset search/list responds ≤2s p95 on ~200 seed assets in the dev environment (smoke only, not the NFR-006 scale test).
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded stack; timing tool (curl -w or autocannon if available).
test_cases.expected_result: p95 ≤2s; results recorded as smoke evidence; deviations filed as low-severity performance notes (full scale test in Cycle 3).

test_cases.title: Performance smoke: dashboard summary ≤3s
test_cases.objective: Verify /dashboard/summary responds within target on seed data.
test_cases.expected_result: p95 ≤3s on seed volume.

test_cases.title: Security response headers present
test_cases.objective: Verify X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, CSP, frame-ancestors (or frame denial) on frontend/backend responses per environment.
steps: Inspect response headers on page and API responses
test_cases.expected_result: Headers set per design §13 (CSP restrictive with nonce bootstrap; nosniff; sensible Referrer-Policy); deviations documented for dev mode.

test_cases.title: Secrets not exposed in API responses, logs, or browser storage
test_cases.objective: Verify no passwords/hashes/secret keys appear in any API payload, backend log output, or localStorage/sessionStorage.
steps: Inspect /auth/me and asset payloads for secret-like fields
Grep backend logs for 'password', 'secret', token values
Inspect browser storage after login (tokens must not be in localStorage)
test_cases.expected_result: No secrets anywhere client-visible; session held only in HttpOnly cookie; logs masked.

test_cases.title: Error responses leak no internals
test_cases.objective: Verify 4xx/5xx responses contain no stack traces, file paths, SQL, framework versions, or DEBUG output.
test_cases.preconditions: Stack running with production-like error handling.
test_cases.test_data: Malformed JSON, invalid UUID, missing fields, forced 500 if hook exists.
test_cases.expected_result: Only envelope content; DEBUG=false behavior confirmed for test settings used in this check.

test_cases.title: Login redirect 'next' parameter is allowlisted (no open redirect)
test_cases.objective: Verify /login?next=https://evil.example or //evil.example does not redirect off-site after login.
steps: Attempt login with malicious next values
test_cases.expected_result: External/malformed next values fall back to default landing (e.g. /); internal paths honored.

test_cases.title: Injection attempts in search/filter inputs handled safely
test_cases.objective: Verify SQL-injection and ORM-probe strings in q/filters return normal results or validation errors, never errors revealing SQL.
test_cases.test_data: q=' OR '1'='1; q=; DROP TABLE assets;-- ; filter with ../../etc/passwd; Unicode probe q=資産テスト.
steps: Send each probe to /search/assets and /assets filters
test_cases.expected_result: No 500s, no SQL leakage, results correctly scoped/empty; Unicode handled per UTF-8 support.

test_cases.title: E2E J-6: sign in, search, and open an asset
test_cases.objective: Verify the canonical journey: user signs in, uses global search (exact-tag-first), opens asset detail.
test_cases.preconditions: Full stack running; seeded asset with known tag.
steps: Navigate to app; redirected to login
Enter tag in global search; use keyboard to select suggestion
Land on asset detail; verify identity header
test_cases.expected_result: Journey completes without errors; detail page shows the correct asset; correlation-ID-bearing error states absent.

test_cases.title: E2E J-1 slice: register a new laptop via UI incl. duplicate warning and 409 handling
test_cases.objective: Verify create-asset flow through the UI: required-field validation, duplicate-warning display, successful save, and stale-version conflict messaging on edit.
test_cases.preconditions: Full stack running; operator user; seeded asset for duplicate serial.
test_cases.test_data: New laptop payload; serial colliding with seeded asset for warning check.
steps: Submit empty form (validation + error summary focus)
Fill form with colliding serial; observe duplicate warning
Save successfully; land on detail showing registration event
Edit in two tabs to force 409; verify conflict prompt
test_cases.expected_result: Each step behaves per FR-003/FR-004 acceptance criteria; success states only after confirmed backend response (no optimistic completion).
